shopPage.subtitle: Prevention and gynaecology supplies for pharmacy, hospital and professional distribution.
shopPage.description: The Gautex catalogue covers regular supply of medical devices for retail, hospital and public-health programmes. Natural latex condoms come in 144-unit boxes: smooth, lubricated and with a reservoir, in a format built for high turnover and professional use. The range also includes gels, barriers and probe covers. Marketed under ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001 and CE marking in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Add products to cart and choose «Request a quote», or use the contact form. We reply within 24–48 business hours.

items.q: Can I customise packaging with my logo?
items.a: Yes. In Campaigns you can choose a format, upload your logo and request a no-obligation quote.
Yes. We market with CE marking under MDR 2017/745, notified body 0120 SGS, plus ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001.
We distribute in Spain and across Europe. Lead times depend on order type and stock.
